H1.intro_zh: 把高处或深处的目标送回交付区。不同身体面对支撑、工具、重量与通行限制，也需要判断何时应安全退出。
H1.intro_en: Retrieve targets from high or deep locations. Different bodies face support, tool, load and passage constraints, including cases requiring a safe exit.

H4.title_en: Bridge a gap to retrieve a load
H4.intro_zh: 缺口把机器人与目标隔开，现场的板材、支撑和把手也各有使用条件。任务变化覆盖搭桥、身体通过和目标无法移出的情况。
H4.intro_en: A gap separates the robot from its target. Boards, supports and handles impose different requirements, spanning bridge construction, body passage and infeasible extraction.

M1.intro_zh: 人形机器人与小型机械臂合作，把货箱中的目标送入低柜。关键是安排独立支撑、交接空间和撤手时机，并识别不允许目标通过的开口。
M1.intro_en: A humanoid and a compact arm move a target from a cargo box into a low cabinet. Support, handoff clearance and release matter, as do openings the target cannot pass.

M3.title_en: Help a partner reach the target
M3.intro_zh: 红球藏在柜内容器里，人形机器人与小型机械臂各自有不同的可达范围。平台、工作台和坡道改变伙伴的工作位置，最终需要把球放入地面托盘。
M3.intro_en: A ball sits inside a shelf container beyond either partner’s straightforward reach. Platforms, worktables and ramps change the compact arm’s working position before delivery to a floor tray.

FRG.intro_zh: 冰箱被墙壁和固定柜体围住，只能从正面接近。机器人需要在狭小间隙和自身平衡约束下，将冰箱移到前方目标区。
FRG.intro_en: Walls and a fixed cabinet surround a refrigerator, leaving frontal access. The robot must move it into the target area while respecting tight clearances and its balance.

SLR.title_zh: 用工具取出狭缝中的物体
SLR.title_en: Retrieve an object through a narrow slot
SLR.intro_zh: 小盒子位于手臂难以直接进入的窄缝深处，附近有一根自由钩杆。机器人要考虑工具的长度、接触位置与固定边界，将盒子取出。
SLR.intro_en: A small box lies deep inside a narrow slot, with a loose hook rod nearby. Retrieval depends on tool reach, contact placement and the fixed boundaries.

H2.title_en: Transport heavy cargo with a cart
H2.intro_zh: 将重货箱送过错位通道并在目标区停稳。机器人需要结合推力、工具接口、路线净空和交付规则，选择适合自身的承托方式。
H2.intro_en: Move heavy cargo through staggered passages and stop in the delivery area. Available force, tool interfaces, clearance and delivery rules shape the transport method.

H5.title_en: Move a heavy crate with lifting tools
H5.intro_zh: 百公斤货箱不能直接抱走，运输时还必须由工具承重。不同身体利用杠杆、支点或托架完成装载与运输，并面对隐藏的摩擦和力量变化。
H5.intro_en: A 100 kg crate must travel on supporting tools rather than be carried or dragged. Different bodies face lifting-tool choices and hidden changes in friction or available force.

H6.title_zh: 把货物送上平台再带回
H6.title_en: Carry cargo up and back down
H6.intro_zh: 任务要求货物到达高处平台，再回到底部交付。楼梯、坡道、升降梯与送货井提供不同路线，箱子重量和身体能力决定哪些路线可用。
H6.intro_en: Cargo must reach an upper platform and return for delivery. Stairs, ramps, lifts and a goods elevator offer routes whose feasibility depends on the body and load.

M2.intro_zh: 长箱从地面出发，需要多台机器人协调承托、转向和释放。任务包含不同身体组合、加重、接收架交付和通道清障。
M2.intro_en: Robots coordinate support, turning and release of a long crate starting on the floor. Variants change the team, mass, receiving supports and obstacles.

M4.intro_zh: 货物由地面或平台承重，机器人通过已连接的绳索牵引前进。不同数量的人形与四足机器人需要协调方向，在转角处保持货物与通道的间隙。
M4.intro_en: Cargo remains supported by the floor or platform while robots tow it through preconnected ropes. Humanoid and quadruped teams coordinate direction and clearance at the turn.

F5.title_zh: 协作搬运与安装柔性面板
F5.title_en: Carry and install a flexible panel together
F5.intro_zh: 两台单臂轮式机器人共同处理半柔性面板。门道、转角和安装框限制可用姿态，任务还包含工具撤离与卡边后的恢复。
F5.intro_en: Two single-arm mobile robots handle a semi-flexible panel. Doorways, corners and frames constrain its pose, with variants covering tool withdrawal and recovery from a jam.

ASM.title_zh: 用支撑稳定工件再装配
ASM.intro_zh: 倾斜夹具需要可靠的独立支撑，才能完成套筒与顶盖装配。任务从单件支撑扩展到选择、组合与不同操作方式，最终都要撤手后保持稳定。
ASM.intro_en: An inclined fixture needs independent support for sleeve and cap assembly. Tasks vary support selection, combination and handling method, ending with stable release.

GEAR.title_zh: 装配、检验与修复齿轮组
GEAR.intro_zh: 机器人按照装配关系安放齿轮与顶盖，再用实体工具检查传动。部分任务从故障状态开始，或改变手型和候选工具，要求恢复功能后释放。
GEAR.intro_en: Arrange gears and a cover, then test transmission with a physical tool. Variants begin with a fault or change hands and tool choices, requiring a functional assembly and final release.

JNG.intro_zh: 从木塔中取出合法木条并放到塔顶，同时避免破坏剩余结构。任务变化涉及抽取顺序、手部与空间适配，以及探测松紧后调整选择。
JNG.intro_en: Remove eligible blocks and place them on top while preserving the tower. Variants test ordering, hand and access constraints, and adapting choices after probing friction.

DF.intro_zh: 在速度和接触力限制下，把圆盘翻面并稳定放回目标位置。圆盘边缘、局部受力上限和单臂或双臂配置改变抓持与支撑的条件。
DF.intro_en: Flip a disk and settle it at the target under speed and force limits. Rim geometry, local load limits and single- versus dual-arm bodies change support and grasping conditions.

DR.title_en: Rotate a disk with two arms
DR.intro_zh: 两台固定机械臂通过接触使圆盘转到指定角度，同时尽量保持圆心不动。两个配置分别覆盖普通转角与跨越角度表示边界的方向判断。
DR.intro_en: Two fixed arms rotate a disk to a target orientation while keeping its center in place. Cases cover an ordinary rotation and direction selection across the angular wrap boundary.

FT.intro_zh: 把三只易碎烧瓶送到目标桌，避免挤压、冲击和不稳定释放。身体、搬运工具、路程与隐藏的湿滑或老化条件共同决定可行操作。
FT.intro_en: Deliver three fragile flasks without crushing, impact damage or unstable release. Bodies, carrying tools, route length and hidden slippery or aged components shape feasible actions.

H1S-01.title_en: Carry a stool to reach a box
H1S-01.description_zh: 红箱放在地面够不到的高层板上，凳子则停在远处。G1 需要安排支撑和带载返回，把目标送入地面交付区并释放。
H1S-01.description_en: A red box sits on a high shelf and the stool starts away from it. G1 must arrange support and a loaded return to the floor delivery area.
H1S-01.scope_zh: 参考执行关闭机器人自碰撞。
H1S-01.scope_en: Robot self-collision is disabled in this reference.

H1S-02.title_en: Move a wide box with five-finger hands
H1S-02.description_zh: 无把手宽箱放在臂高附近的窄台座上，需要送到较低的平台。此项考察同一 G1 身体换装五指手后，对宽箱抓持和稳定释放的适配。
H1S-02.description_en: A wide handleless box must move from a narrow pedestal to a lower platform. This G1 configuration uses five-finger hands to grasp and release it.
H1S-02.scope_zh: 简化为取放任务，不含支撑布置或登高；本片为 Inspire 手配置。
H1S-02.scope_en: Simplified pick-and-place without support placement or climbing; this video uses Inspire hands.

H1S-03.title_zh: 轮式机器人借坡道取物
H1S-03.title_en: Reach a high target using a ramp
H1S-03.description_zh: 目标在高处柜顶，从地面无法直接够到，斜坡起初也未就位。R1 需要处理坡道位置与上下坡载荷，把目标送到桌面交付区。
H1S-03.description_en: The target is beyond floor-level reach and the ramp is misplaced. R1 must manage ramp placement and the loaded route to a tabletop delivery area.

H1S-04.title_zh: A3 布置支撑取高处箱子
H1S-04.title_en: A3 retrieves a high box using support
H1S-04.description_zh: 轻型提手箱位于高处柜顶，地面的重支撑箱尚未就位。A3 要在搬举规则与身体平衡约束下建立工作位置，再将目标送回地面。
H1S-04.description_en: A light handled box sits high on a cabinet, with a heavy support box out of place. A3 must establish a working position and return the target to the floor.

H1S-05.description_zh: 柜顶的提手箱需要送回地面，现场两块台阶箱起初都不在工作位。A3 要安排支撑、取物与返回之间的衔接，最后释放目标并停稳。
H1S-05.description_en: A handled box must travel from the cabinet top to the floor. Two step boxes start out of place, requiring coordinated support setup, retrieval and return.
H1S-05.scope_zh: 单层简化示范，不代表原双层登高任务。
H1S-05.scope_en: Simplified single-level demonstration, not the original two-level climbing task.

H1S-06.title_zh: 封闭隔间前的安全退出
H1S-06.title_en: Safe exit from a sealed compartment
H1S-06.description_zh: 红箱被固定封板包围，狭小缝隙无法让目标通过，现场也没有可用工具。机器人需要识别这一限制，保持空手进入退出区并停稳。
H1S-06.description_en: Fixed panels enclose the box with no usable passage or tool. The robot must recognize the constraint and stop empty-handed in the exit area.
H1S-06.scope_zh: 目标是正确退出，不计作取物交付。
H1S-06.scope_en: The goal is a correct exit, not target delivery.

H1S-07.P1.description_zh: 重障碍箱挡住了凳子的工作位置，按搬举规则只能推而不能抬。G1 还要完成高处取物与地面交付，因此清障必须为后续动作留下空间。
H1S-07.P1.description_en: A heavy obstacle blocks the stool’s working position and may only be pushed. G1 must leave enough room for high-shelf retrieval and floor delivery.
H1S-07.P1.scope_zh: 扩展参考；原 H1 严格评分因过程接触判为无效，不能沿用其通过结论。
H1S-07.P1.scope_en: Extension reference; the original H1 strict rubric marked the run invalid because of intermediate contact.

H1S-07.P2.title_zh: 推动重箱搭建取物平台
H1S-07.P2.title_en: Push a heavy box into a support position
H1S-07.P2.description_zh: 取物支撑换成超过搬举限额的重箱，起初偏离柜前工作位。机器人只能在地面推移它，再完成高处取箱、返回和稳定释放。
H1S-07.P2.description_en: The support is a box above the lifting limit and starts away from the cabinet. It must be pushed into place before retrieval and stable delivery.

H1S-07.P3.title_zh: 绕开挡块调整支撑位置
H1S-07.P3.title_en: Place a support around a fixed obstacle
H1S-07.P3.description_zh: 固定挡块限制了支撑箱通往柜前的路线，直接推动会发生碰撞。G1 要考虑接触位置和箱子的转向空间，同时为高处取物与返回保留通路。
H1S-07.P3.description_en: A fixed block obstructs direct support placement. G1 must account for pushing contact and turning space while keeping a route for retrieval and return.

H1S-07.P4.title_zh: 把超搬举限额的箱子推入目标区
H1S-07.P4.title_en: Push a box above the lifting limit
H1S-07.P4.description_zh: 无把手重箱放在地面，质量超过公开搬举限额，但允许地面承托推动。G1 需要控制接触与箱子方向，使它完整进入目标区并稳定释放。
H1S-07.P4.description_en: A heavy handleless box exceeds the lifting rule but may be pushed along the floor. G1 must control contact and direction to settle it fully inside the target.
H1S-07.P4.scope_zh: 搬举限制是任务规则，不等于硬件抬举能力测量。
H1S-07.P4.scope_en: The lifting limit is a task rule, not a measured hardware capacity.

H1S-08.title_zh: Stretch 取出层架中的提手箱
H1S-08.title_en: Stretch retrieves a handled shelf box
H1S-08.description_zh: 带把手的轻箱位于封闭层架内，目标区在地面。Stretch 只有单夹爪可以接触可动物体，需要协调伸缩臂与底盘完成取出和低处释放。
H1S-08.description_en: A light handled box sits inside a shelf and must reach the floor. Only Stretch’s gripper may contact movable objects, constraining retrieval and low placement.

H1S-09.title_zh: 超重目标前的安全退出
H1S-09.title_en: Exit when the target exceeds the lifting rule
H1S-09.description_zh: 层架和提手箱的位置与轻载场景相同，但箱子质量提高到三公斤。机器人需要遵守两公斤搬举规则，不接触目标，空手进入退出区停稳。
H1S-09.description_en: The shelf geometry matches the light-load case, but the box weighs 3 kg. Stretch must respect the 2 kg lifting rule and exit without touching it.
H1S-09.scope_zh: 正确目标为空手退出，不是尝试抬起超限载荷。
H1S-09.scope_en: The goal is an empty-handed exit rather than attempting the prohibited lift.

H1S-10.A.title_zh: G1 从多个支撑中作选择
H1S-10.A.description_zh: 柜前有高度和顶面大小不同的候选支撑，全部尚未就位。G1 需要结合可搬运性、落脚空间和目标高度，安排高处取物与地面交付。
H1S-10.A.description_en: Several supports differ in height and top area, and none is in place. G1 must consider handling, footholds and target height before retrieval and delivery.

H1S-10.B.title_zh: A3 选择合适的支撑箱
H1S-10.B.description_zh: 四个候选箱在高度、重量和顶面大小上各不相同，目标位于高处柜顶。A3 需要判断支撑与自身身体是否匹配，再完成取物和返回。
H1S-10.B.description_en: Four boxes differ in height, mass and top area beneath a high cabinet target. A3 must match support geometry to its body before retrieval and return.

H1S-10.C.title_zh: 组合坡道与平台接近目标
H1S-10.C.description_zh: 多个平台和斜坡可以形成不同搭配，但都需要实际移动到位。R1 要考虑坡度、搭接和顶面空间，让高处目标进入可操作范围并完成交付。
H1S-10.C.description_en: Platforms and ramps offer different combinations but must be physically positioned. R1 must consider slope, overlap and working space to retrieve the high target.

H1S-10.D.description_zh: 低净空层架限制了目标的取出姿态，附近候选箱的高度、把手和空余顶面不同。Stretch 需要安排可用中转位置，将目标送到地面交付区。
H1S-10.D.description_en: Low shelf clearance constrains removal. Candidate boxes differ in height, handle position and free top area, requiring a suitable transfer arrangement for floor delivery.

H1S-11.A.description_zh: 带提手与拉环的目标放在层架前部，旁边还有一把钩子。Stretch 要判断当前深度下的可达范围，完成取出与桌面交付。
H1S-11.A.description_en: A box with a handle and loop sits near the shelf front, with a hook nearby. Stretch must assess reach at this depth and deliver it to the table.

H1S-11.B.description_zh: 同一个目标移到了手臂直接够不到的层架深处，现场提供被动钩子。机器人需要把工具长度和接触方式纳入考虑，且拉动时不能让箱子失去层板支撑。
H1S-11.B.description_en: The target moves deeper beyond direct reach, with a passive hook available. Tool reach and contact matter, and the box must remain shelf-supported while being pulled.

H1S-11.C.title_zh: 工具也无法够到时退出
H1S-11.C.title_en: Exit when the tool cannot reach
H1S-11.C.description_zh: 目标被放到更深的柜内，即使加上现有钩子也超出声明的可达范围。Stretch 应保持目标与工具不动，空手进入退出区并停稳。
H1S-11.C.description_en: The target is deeper than the declared reach even with the available hook. Stretch must leave both untouched and stop empty-handed in the exit area.
H1S-11.C.scope_zh: 不可行判断依赖公开工具使用规则和几何范围。
H1S-11.C.scope_en: Infeasibility depends on the declared tool-use rules and geometry.

H1S-12.title_zh: 在同色干扰物中取对目标
H1S-12.title_en: Retrieve the target among matching decoys
H1S-12.description_zh: 柜内和中转面上有多个同色同尺寸替身，真正目标位于高层板上。G1 需要保持目标身份一致，完成支撑布置与交付，同时避免扰动替身。
H1S-12.description_en: Matching decoys occupy the shelf and transfer surface. G1 must preserve target identity through support setup and delivery while avoiding disturbance to the decoys.
H1S-12.scope_zh: 参考通过仿真状态读取目标身份，未验证视觉识别。
H1S-12.scope_en: Target identity comes from simulator state; visual recognition is not evaluated.

H1S-13.title_zh: 自行安排取物后的返回方式
H1S-13.title_en: Choose how to return with the target
H1S-13.description_zh: 高处取物后，机器人需要把箱子送入地面交付区并站稳。指令不指定中转方法，现场层板是否适合临时放置也需要纳入行动安排。
H1S-13.description_en: After high-shelf retrieval, the box must reach the floor delivery area. The instruction leaves transfer choices open, including whether a shelf can serve as temporary support.
H1S-13.scope_zh: 简化场景；未证明必须使用中转面。
H1S-13.scope_en: Simplified scene; intermediate support is not proven necessary.

H1S-14.title_zh: 穿过窄门搬运支撑与目标
H1S-14.title_en: Move support and cargo through a doorway
H1S-14.description_zh: 隔墙把起点与柜子分开，只留下有限宽度的门洞。G1 搬凳和带载返回都要通过这里，需要兼顾身体、支撑和目标的通行间隙。
H1S-14.description_en: A wall separates the start from the cabinet, leaving a doorway. Both stool placement and the loaded return must respect clearance for the body and carried object.

H4-B01.W.title_en: Choose a bridge for a wheeled base
H4-B01.W.description_zh: 缺口另一侧的目标需要带回，现场桥板的宽度并不都适合轮式底盘。R1 要兼顾轮距、板端支撑和载物通行，建立可以往返的通路。
H4-B01.W.description_en: R1 must bring a target back across a gap. Board width, wheel spacing, end support and loaded clearance determine a usable crossing.
H4-B01.W.scope_zh: 本项采用放宽时限的简化交付范围。
H4-B01.W.scope_en: This case uses a simplified delivery scope with an extended time allowance.

H4-B02.S.title_en: Build a crossing with a single arm
H4-B02.S.description_zh: 桥板斜靠在起点，板端还需要考虑楔块带来的支撑条件。Stretch 要用单臂与底盘协调布置通路，跨过缺口取回目标并稳定放下。
H4-B02.S.description_en: A leaning board and end wedges must form a usable crossing. Stretch coordinates its single arm and base to retrieve and settle the target.
H4-B02.S.scope_zh: 本项采用放宽时限的简化范围；脚轮使用滑动球近似。
H4-B02.S.scope_en: Extended-time simplified scope; casters are approximated by sliding spheres.

H4-B03.W.title_zh: 在重板与宽板之间作选择
H4-B03.W.title_en: Choose between heavy and wide boards
H4-B03.W.description_zh: 现场有平放的重板，也有适合轮式身体的宽板，候选并非都能使用。R1 需要结合搬动能力和通行尺寸，安排跨越缺口的取物路线。
H4-B03.W.description_en: A heavy flat board and a wide board offer different handling and clearance constraints. R1 must select a feasible arrangement for retrieval across the gap.
H4-B03.W.scope_zh: 使用独立声明的重板候选场景，采用放宽时限的简化范围。
H4-B03.W.scope_en: Separately declared heavy-board scene with an extended-time simplified scope.

H4-B04.A.title_zh: A3 操作近乎竖直的桥板
H4-B04.A.title_en: A3 handles a nearly upright bridge board
H4-B04.A.description_zh: 重桥板以近乎竖直的姿态摆放，附近有固定支撑和挡边。A3 需要控制板的接触与落位，形成稳定通路，再完成载物往返。
H4-B04.A.description_en: A heavy board starts nearly upright beside fixed supports and lips. A3 must control its placement to create a stable route for a loaded return.
H4-B04.A.scope_zh: 独立改设的桥板与支撑场景；采用放宽时限的简化范围。
H4-B04.A.scope_en: Separately modified board-and-support scene with an extended-time simplified scope.

H4-B04.G.title_zh: G1 调整推板的接触位置
H4-B04.G.title_en: G1 adjusts contact on a bridge board
H4-B04.G.description_zh: 桥板和两只支架都可自由运动，推板的位置会影响它们的受力与落位。G1 要在布置通路时避免失稳，再取回缺口另一侧的目标。
H4-B04.G.description_en: The board and both stands can move freely. G1 must account for how pushing contact affects their loading and placement before retrieving the target.
H4-B04.G.scope_zh: 使用十二公斤桥板与自由支架的独立配置。
H4-B04.G.scope_en: Separate configuration with a 12 kg board and movable stands.

H4-B05.G.title_zh: 为长箱选择合适的把手
H4-B05.G.title_en: Choose a handle for a long crate
H4-B05.G.description_zh: 长箱提供偏置和居中两种把手，载荷分布会改变抓持后的姿态。G1 需要考虑把手位置与搬运平衡，将箱子经过通路送入交付区。
H4-B05.G.description_en: A long crate has offset and centered handles. G1 must consider grasp location and balance when carrying it through the route to delivery.

H4-B06.A.description_zh: 缺口缩窄后，身体直接通过也成为需要评估的可能。A3 要把空载与带载时的步幅、平衡和落脚空间一起考虑，完成目标取回。
H4-B06.A.description_en: A narrower gap makes direct passage a candidate. A3 must consider step reach, balance and landing space both empty-handed and carrying the target.
H4-B06.A.scope_zh: 缺口宽三十厘米；采用放宽时限的简化范围。
H4-B06.A.scope_en: The gap is 30 cm wide; this case uses an extended-time simplified scope.

H4-B06.G.title_zh: 目标被固定时停止取物
H4-B06.G.title_en: Decline retrieval of a fixed target
H4-B06.G.description_zh: 桥已经搭好，但目标被固定且没有合法解锁方式。G1 需要区分通路可达与目标可移动，识别限制后停止取物并作出正确拒绝。
H4-B06.G.description_en: The bridge is ready, but the target is fixed with no permitted release. G1 must distinguish route access from target mobility and correctly decline retrieval.
H4-B06.G.scope_zh: 预设桥的不可行对照；正确拒绝不计作目标交付。
H4-B06.G.scope_en: Infeasible control with a preset bridge; correct refusal is not delivery.

M1C-ORIG.title_zh: 双机取出目标并送入低柜
M1C-ORIG.title_en: Retrieve and place a target in a low cabinet
M1C-ORIG.description_zh: 目标位于货箱内，人形机器人和小型机械臂各有可达限制。两台机器人需要安排货箱支撑与目标交接，将目标放入低柜后完全撤出。
M1C-ORIG.description_en: A target inside a cargo box must reach a low cabinet. G1 and X5 must coordinate box support, access and handoff, then withdraw after placement.

M1C-B01-A.title_zh: 手臂力量受限时移动货箱
M1C-B01-A.title_en: Move the cargo box with limited arm torque
M1C-B01-A.description_zh: 货箱放在连续工作台与罩体下，G1 的手臂力矩受到限制。双机需要在保持承托的条件下取得目标，再完成低柜内的放置和撤出。
M1C-B01-A.description_en: The cargo box sits on a continuous worktop beneath a cover, with reduced G1 arm torque. The team must obtain the target while maintaining support and deliver it into the cabinet.
M1C-B01-A.scope_zh: 声明配置为四公斤货箱、手臂力矩上限百分之二十；不代表已测得完整能力边界。
M1C-B01-A.scope_en: Declared 4 kg box and 20% arm-torque limit; this does not establish a general capability boundary.

M1C-B02-A.title_zh: 为伙伴建立独立取物支撑
M1C-B02-A.description_zh: 现场有多个支撑候选，货箱需要在机器人撤手后仍能稳定承托。G1 与 X5 要协调支撑安排和取物空间，把目标送入低柜并释放。
M1C-B02-A.description_en: Several support candidates are available. G1 and X5 must arrange stable support that remains after release, obtain the target and place it inside the low cabinet.

M1C-B06-A.title_zh: 在有限撤出空间内交接目标
M1C-B06-A.title_en: Hand off a target with limited withdrawal space
M1C-B06-A.description_zh: 货箱边缘限制了手和目标的撤出方向，两台机器人还需完成实际交接。任务要求目标最终由低柜承托，机器人松手并退出接触区域。
M1C-B06-A.description_en: The box rim constrains withdrawal of the hand and target. The two robots must complete a physical handoff and leave the target supported inside the cabinet.

M1C-I01-A.title_zh: 取物口过小时双机退出
M1C-I01-A.title_en: Both robots exit when the opening is too small
M1C-I01-A.description_zh: 刚性目标被连续外壳围住，唯一取物口比目标本体更小。两台机器人需要判断不能合法取出，保持空手进入各自退出区并稳定停留。
M1C-I01-A.description_en: A continuous shell surrounds a rigid target, with its only opening smaller than the object. Both robots must recognize infeasibility and stop empty-handed in their exit areas.
M1C-I01-A.scope_zh: 几何不可行对照；目标是双机正确退出。
M1C-I01-A.scope_en: Geometrically infeasible control; the goal is a correct two-robot exit.

M3C-ORIG.title_zh: 让机械臂伙伴接近柜内红球
M3C-ORIG.title_en: Bring an arm partner within reach of a ball
M3C-ORIG.description_zh: 红球位于低矮柜内容器中，G1 难以伸手进入，伙伴的底座又太低。两台机器人需要改变工作位置并协作，将球放入地面托盘后独立停稳。
M3C-ORIG.description_en: A ball lies inside a low shelf container beyond G1’s access and the partner’s floor-level reach. The team must change working positions and deliver it to a floor tray.
M3C-ORIG.scope_zh: 原重 X5 按原基准豁免处理，不受扩展任务两公斤外载规则约束。
M3C-ORIG.scope_en: The original heavy X5 uses the original benchmark exemption, not the extension’s 2 kg external-load rule.

M3C-B01.title_zh: 借预置平台支持轻量伙伴取物
M3C-B01.title_en: Use a preset platform for a lightweight partner
M3C-B01.description_zh: 柜前已有平台，但轻量机械臂伙伴仍在地面，够不到容器中的红球。机器人需要让伙伴获得独立支撑，完成取球与地面托盘交付。
M3C-B01.description_en: A platform is ready, but the lightweight arm partner starts on the floor below the ball’s reach. It needs independent support to retrieve and deliver the ball.
M3C-B01.scope_zh: 轻量 WX200 配置；伙伴连同球的质量为两公斤。
M3C-B01.scope_en: Lightweight WX200 configuration; partner plus ball weighs 2 kg.

M3C-B02.title_zh: 工作台未就位时协作取物
M3C-B02.title_en: Retrieve with a worktable initially out of place
M3C-B02.description_zh: 可移动平台距离柜前工作位还有一段距离，伙伴不能一直被悬空承托。双机需要实际调整工作环境，使轻量机械臂能独立取球并完成交付。
M3C-B02.description_en: The movable platform starts away from the cabinet, and the partner cannot remain suspended during retrieval. The team must reposition the workspace for independently supported ball handling.

M3C-B03.title_zh: 重伙伴利用坡道接近目标
M3C-B03.title_en: A heavy partner approaches through a ramp
M3C-B03.description_zh: 伙伴重量超过扩展搬举限额，但柜前增加了通向平台的固定坡道。任务需要评估轮式伙伴的通行和带载返回条件，最终把红球放进托盘。
M3C-B03.description_en: The heavy partner exceeds the extension’s lifting rule, but a fixed ramp reaches the platform. Its passage and loaded return must be assessed for ball delivery.
M3C-B03.scope_zh: 取物时包含与固定容器的接触辅助；不代表全程自由平台承重。
M3C-B03.scope_en: Retrieval includes contact assistance from the fixed container; it is not wholly free-platform support.

M3C-B04.title_zh: 坡道在场但伙伴没有驱动轮
M3C-B04.title_en: A ramp is available to a partner without drive motors
M3C-B04.description_zh: 平台旁增加了坡道，但轻量伙伴没有行驶电机，不能把坡道视为自动可用。G1 与伙伴仍需结合身体能力，安排独立支撑和红球交付。
M3C-B04.description_en: A ramp reaches the platform, but the lightweight partner has no drive motors. The team must account for this limitation when arranging support and ball delivery.

M3C-I01.title_zh: 容器被封闭时全员退出
M3C-I01.title_en: Both partners exit from a sealed-container task
M3C-I01.description_zh: 可见的固定盖板把红球封在刚性容器中，坡道和平台无法改变这道边界。双机需要停止取物，空手进入各自退出位置并同时停稳。
M3C-I01.description_en: A visible fixed lid seals the ball inside a rigid container. Ramps and platforms cannot change that boundary, so both partners must exit empty-handed and stop together.
M3C-I01.scope_zh: 目标是正确退出，不计作红球交付。
M3C-I01.scope_en: The goal is a correct exit, not ball delivery.

FRG-01.title_en: Pull a refrigerator from a confined corner
FRG-01.description_zh: 冰箱背面与一侧贴墙，另一侧紧邻固定柜体，只留下很窄的间隙。G1 要利用正面可接近的接触位置，将冰箱移到前方目标区并保持平衡。
FRG-01.description_en: Walls and a cabinet tightly surround the refrigerator. G1 must use front-accessible contact to move it into the target area while maintaining balance.

SLR-01.title_zh: 取出窄缝深处的小盒子
SLR-01.title_en: Retrieve a small box from a deep slot
SLR-01.description_zh: 黄色小盒子藏在固定侧壁与顶盖围成的窄缝深处，台面上有一根自由钩杆。机器人需要控制工具穿入后的接触和路径，将盒子安全取出。
SLR-01.description_en: A small yellow box sits deep in a slot bounded by fixed walls and a roof. A loose hook rod requires controlled insertion, contact and withdrawal for retrieval.

H4-I01.A.title_zh: A3 判断目标能否穿过开口
H4-I01.A.description_zh: 桥已预设，但目标被围在刚性围室中，唯一开口小于目标尺寸。A3 需要区分能接近目标与能把它移出，识别不可行后作出正确拒绝。
H4-I01.A.description_en: The bridge is preset, but the rigid enclosure has an opening smaller than the target. A3 must distinguish access from extractability and correctly decline.
H4-I01.A.scope_zh: 预设桥的不可行对照；不计作目标交付。
H4-I01.A.scope_en: Infeasible control with a preset bridge; not target delivery.

H4-I01.G.title_zh: G1 判断目标能否穿过开口
H4-I01.G.description_zh: 桥已预设，但目标被围在刚性围室中，唯一开口小于目标尺寸。G1 需要区分能接近目标与能把它移出，识别不可行后作出正确拒绝。
H4-I01.G.description_en: The bridge is preset, but the rigid enclosure has an opening smaller than the target. G1 must distinguish access from extractability and correctly decline.
H4-I01.G.scope_zh: 预设桥的不可行对照；不计作目标交付。
H4-I01.G.scope_en: Infeasible control with a preset bridge; not target delivery.

H4-I01.S.title_zh: Stretch 判断目标能否穿过开口
H4-I01.S.description_zh: 桥已预设，但目标被围在刚性围室中，唯一开口小于目标尺寸。Stretch 需要区分能接近目标与能把它移出，识别不可行后作出正确拒绝。
H4-I01.S.description_en: The bridge is preset, but the rigid enclosure has an opening smaller than the target. Stretch must distinguish access from extractability and correctly decline.
H4-I01.S.scope_zh: 预设桥的不可行对照；不计作目标交付。
H4-I01.S.scope_en: Infeasible control with a preset bridge; not target delivery.

H4-I01.W.title_zh: R1 判断目标能否穿过开口
H4-I01.W.description_zh: 桥已预设，但目标被围在刚性围室中，唯一开口小于目标尺寸。R1 需要区分能接近目标与能把它移出，识别不可行后作出正确拒绝。
H4-I01.W.description_en: The bridge is preset, but the rigid enclosure has an opening smaller than the target. R1 must distinguish access from extractability and correctly decline.
H4-I01.W.scope_zh: 预设桥的不可行对照；不计作目标交付。
H4-I01.W.scope_en: Infeasible control with a preset bridge; not target delivery.

H4-I02.S.title_zh: Stretch 判断底盘能否通过狭廊
H4-I02.S.description_zh: 目标路线经过全高封闭狭廊，宽度小于当前身体的底盘通行下界。Stretch 需要识别几何限制，避免把已有桥面误当成整条路线可行。
H4-I02.S.description_en: The route crosses a full-height corridor narrower than the base can pass. Stretch must recognize that a ready bridge does not make the whole route feasible.
H4-I02.S.scope_zh: 正确拒绝的不可行对照；桥已预设。
H4-I02.S.scope_en: Infeasible control requiring correct refusal; the bridge is preset.

H4-I02.W.title_zh: R1 判断底盘能否通过狭廊
H4-I02.W.description_zh: 目标路线经过全高封闭狭廊，宽度小于当前身体的底盘通行下界。R1 需要识别几何限制，避免把已有桥面误当成整条路线可行。
H4-I02.W.description_en: The route crosses a full-height corridor narrower than the base can pass. R1 must recognize that a ready bridge does not make the whole route feasible.
H4-I02.W.scope_zh: 正确拒绝的不可行对照；桥已预设。
H4-I02.W.scope_en: Infeasible control requiring correct refusal; the bridge is preset.

H4-ORIG.L1.G.title_en: Bridge a gap to retrieve a crate
H4-ORIG.L1.G.description_zh: 一点一米宽的缺口隔开目标与交付区，G1 要安排稳定通路并完成载物往返。现场仅提供原任务的桥板与支撑条件。
H4-ORIG.L1.G.description_en: A 1.1 m gap separates the target and delivery area; G1 needs a stable loaded crossing. The scene provides the original board and support arrangement.

H4-ORIG.L2.G.title_en: Build a crossing with a heavy-board distractor
H4-ORIG.L2.G.description_zh: 一点一米宽的缺口隔开目标与交付区，G1 要安排稳定通路并完成载物往返。现场另有重板候选，需要区分可搬动与可通行的工具。
H4-ORIG.L2.G.description_en: A 1.1 m gap separates the target and delivery area; G1 needs a stable loaded crossing. An additional heavy board tests whether a candidate is both manageable and traversable.

H4-ORIG.L3.G.title_zh: 多物体场景中搭桥取箱
H4-ORIG.L3.G.title_en: Build a crossing among several objects
H4-ORIG.L3.G.description_zh: 一点一米宽的缺口隔开目标与交付区，G1 要安排稳定通路并完成载物往返。更多物体占据现场，需要分清有效工具与干扰物。
H4-ORIG.L3.G.description_en: A 1.1 m gap separates the target and delivery area; G1 needs a stable loaded crossing. Additional objects require distinguishing useful tools from distractors.

M1C-I02-A.title_zh: 三指手配置面对过小柜口
M1C-I02-A.title_en: Three-finger configuration at a narrow cabinet opening
M1C-I02-A.description_zh: 低柜的唯一入口高度小于刚性目标尺寸，换用三指手也不能改变目标本体的通行条件。两台机器人需要放弃交付，空手进入各自退出区并停稳。
M1C-I02-A.description_en: The cabinet’s only opening is smaller than the rigid target. Changing to three-finger hands cannot change object clearance; both robots must exit empty-handed.
M1C-I02-A.scope_zh: 正确退出的几何对照；本片使用Dex3 三指手。
M1C-I02-A.scope_en: Geometric correct-exit control using Dex3 three-finger hands.

M1C-I02-B.title_zh: 五指手配置面对过小柜口
M1C-I02-B.title_en: Five-finger configuration at a narrow cabinet opening
M1C-I02-B.description_zh: 低柜的唯一入口高度小于刚性目标尺寸，换用五指手也不能改变目标本体的通行条件。两台机器人需要放弃交付，空手进入各自退出区并停稳。
M1C-I02-B.description_en: The cabinet’s only opening is smaller than the rigid target. Changing to five-finger hands cannot change object clearance; both robots must exit empty-handed.
M1C-I02-B.scope_zh: 正确退出的几何对照；本片使用Inspire 五指手。
M1C-I02-B.scope_en: Geometric correct-exit control using Inspire five-finger hands.

H2C-ORIG-L1.title_zh: 重货箱装车穿过错位通道
H2C-ORIG-L1.title_en: Load a cart through staggered passages
H2C-ORIG-L1.description_zh: G1 要将二十公斤货箱留在车上，送过错位通道并直立停稳。现场只有基本托盘车，关键是装载与两道通道的转向空间。
H2C-ORIG-L1.description_en: G1 must keep a 20 kg crate on its cart, pass staggered openings and stop upright. Only the basic cart is available, emphasizing loading and turning clearance.

H2C-ORIG-L2.title_zh: 不同工具接口下推车运货
H2C-ORIG-L2.title_en: Transport cargo among different tool interfaces
H2C-ORIG-L2.description_zh: G1 要将二十公斤货箱留在车上，送过错位通道并直立停稳。新增低位推杆、牵引杆与拖板，工具接口不一定适合 G1。
H2C-ORIG-L2.description_en: G1 must keep a 20 kg crate on its cart, pass staggered openings and stop upright. Added low push and pull bars and a sled do not necessarily fit G1.

H2C-ORIG-L3.title_zh: 排除无效工具后推车运货
H2C-ORIG-L3.title_en: Transport cargo with unusable tool distractors
H2C-ORIG-L3.description_zh: G1 要将二十公斤货箱留在车上，送过错位通道并直立停稳。现场还有过宽车板、游离把手和固定车等干扰，外形像工具并不等于能完成任务。
H2C-ORIG-L3.description_en: G1 must keep a 20 kg crate on its cart, pass staggered openings and stop upright. A wide cart, loose handle and fixed cart add misleading tool candidates.

H2C-B01-L1.title_zh: 有死巷近路的推车运输
H2C-B01-L1.title_en: Cart transport beside a dead-end shortcut
H2C-B01-L1.description_zh: 看似更短的支路通向封闭死巷，货箱仍须随车抵达交付区。只提供基本推车，需要从路线结构判断能否继续前进。
H2C-B01-L1.description_en: A tempting short branch leads to a closed dead end, while the crate must reach delivery on its cart. Only the basic cart is available, making route connectivity central.

H2C-B01-L2.title_en: A dead end with low tool interfaces
H2C-B01-L2.description_zh: 看似更短的支路通向封闭死巷，货箱仍须随车抵达交付区。新增其他身体可用的低位工具，不能仅凭工具在场假定能从死巷脱困。
H2C-B01-L2.description_en: A tempting short branch leads to a closed dead end, while the crate must reach delivery on its cart. Low tools suited to other bodies do not automatically make escape from the dead end possible.

H2C-B01-L3.title_en: A dead end with tool distractors
H2C-B01-L3.description_zh: 看似更短的支路通向封闭死巷，货箱仍须随车抵达交付区。更多无效工具与死巷同时出现，需要共同考虑工具适配和路线终点。
H2C-B01-L3.description_en: A tempting short branch leads to a closed dead end, while the crate must reach delivery on its cart. Additional unusable tools require joint reasoning about tool fit and route destinations.

H2C-B03-L1-N.title_zh: R1 运货：可选择交付支撑 · 基础工具
H2C-B03-L1-N.title_en: R1 transport: support choice with basic tools
H2C-B03-L1-N.description_zh: R1 需要把二十公斤货箱送过错位通道，本项允许车或地面等合规支撑交付。只有基本托盘车可用，需要把工具适配与交付规则一起考虑。
H2C-B03-L1-N.description_en: R1 must move a 20 kg crate through staggered passages; this case permits any compliant stable support, including the floor. Only the basic cart is present, requiring attention to both tool fit and delivery rules.
H2C-B03-L1-N.scope_zh: 本片采用车上交付；允许地面支撑不等于本片展示不用车路线。
H2C-B03-L1-N.scope_en: This video delivers on the cart; allowing floor support does not mean this record demonstrates a cart-free route.

H2C-B03-L1-Y.title_zh: R1 运货：必须随车交付 · 基础工具
H2C-B03-L1-Y.title_en: R1 transport: cart required with basic tools
H2C-B03-L1-Y.description_zh: R1 需要把二十公斤货箱送过错位通道，本项要求货箱始终留在车上交付。只有基本托盘车可用，需要把工具适配与交付规则一起考虑。
H2C-B03-L1-Y.description_en: R1 must move a 20 kg crate through staggered passages; this case requires delivery on the cart. Only the basic cart is present, requiring attention to both tool fit and delivery rules.

H2C-B03-L2-N.title_zh: R1 运货：可选择交付支撑 · 低位工具
H2C-B03-L2-N.title_en: R1 transport: support choice with low interfaces
H2C-B03-L2-N.description_zh: R1 需要把二十公斤货箱送过错位通道，本项允许车或地面等合规支撑交付。现场增加不适合当前身体的低位工具，需要把工具适配与交付规则一起考虑。
H2C-B03-L2-N.description_en: R1 must move a 20 kg crate through staggered passages; this case permits any compliant stable support, including the floor. Low tool interfaces unsuited to this body are added, requiring attention to both tool fit and delivery rules.
H2C-B03-L2-N.scope_zh: 本片采用车上交付；允许地面支撑不等于本片展示不用车路线。
H2C-B03-L2-N.scope_en: This video delivers on the cart; allowing floor support does not mean this record demonstrates a cart-free route.

H2C-B03-L2-Y.title_zh: R1 运货：必须随车交付 · 低位工具
H2C-B03-L2-Y.title_en: R1 transport: cart required with low interfaces
H2C-B03-L2-Y.description_zh: R1 需要把二十公斤货箱送过错位通道，本项要求货箱始终留在车上交付。现场增加不适合当前身体的低位工具，需要把工具适配与交付规则一起考虑。
H2C-B03-L2-Y.description_en: R1 must move a 20 kg crate through staggered passages; this case requires delivery on the cart. Low tool interfaces unsuited to this body are added, requiring attention to both tool fit and delivery rules.

H2C-B03-L3-N.title_zh: R1 运货：可选择交付支撑 · 工具干扰
H2C-B03-L3-N.title_en: R1 transport: support choice with distractors
H2C-B03-L3-N.description_zh: R1 需要把二十公斤货箱送过错位通道，本项允许车或地面等合规支撑交付。现场再增加过宽或无法移动的工具干扰，需要把工具适配与交付规则一起考虑。
H2C-B03-L3-N.description_en: R1 must move a 20 kg crate through staggered passages; this case permits any compliant stable support, including the floor. Further distractors include oversized or immovable tools, requiring attention to both tool fit and delivery rules.
H2C-B03-L3-N.scope_zh: 本片采用车上交付；允许地面支撑不等于本片展示不用车路线。
H2C-B03-L3-N.scope_en: This video delivers on the cart; allowing floor support does not mean this record demonstrates a cart-free route.

H2C-B03-L3-Y.title_zh: R1 运货：必须随车交付 · 工具干扰
H2C-B03-L3-Y.title_en: R1 transport: cart required with distractors
H2C-B03-L3-Y.description_zh: R1 需要把二十公斤货箱送过错位通道，本项要求货箱始终留在车上交付。现场再增加过宽或无法移动的工具干扰，需要把工具适配与交付规则一起考虑。
H2C-B03-L3-Y.description_en: R1 must move a 20 kg crate through staggered passages; this case requires delivery on the cart. Further distractors include oversized or immovable tools, requiring attention to both tool fit and delivery rules.

H2C-B03-R0-L1-N.title_zh: R1 不用车的地面推箱
H2C-B03-R0-L1-N.title_en: R1 pushes cargo without cart support
H2C-B03-R0-L1-N.description_zh: 相同错位通道中，交付规则允许货箱由地面承托。此项要求全过程不借车承重，R1 需要控制推箱接触、转弯和末端停稳。
H2C-B03-R0-L1-N.description_en: The same staggered corridor permits floor-supported delivery. This case requires no cart support throughout, testing pushing contact, turning and final settling.

H2C-B04.title_zh: Stretch 单臂与底盘协调推车
H2C-B04.title_en: Stretch coordinates arm and base to push a cart
H2C-B04.description_zh: 二十公斤货箱需要装车并穿过两道错位通道，伸缩臂的行程和推力有限。Stretch 要协调底盘接近与接触位置，使货物始终随车稳定移动。
H2C-B04.description_en: A 20 kg crate must be loaded and pass two staggered openings. Stretch’s limited arm stroke and force require coordination with the base for stable cart motion.
H2C-B04.scope_zh: 轮地摩擦采用模型假设；本项保留原记录的路缘接触。
H2C-B04.scope_en: Wheel-ground friction is a model assumption; the recorded curb contact remains part of this reference.

H2C-B04-L3.title_zh: Stretch 面对额外工具干扰
H2C-B04-L3.title_en: Stretch transports cargo amid tool distractors
H2C-B04-L3.description_zh: 推车路线和重货箱不变，现场新增外形可用却不满足任务条件的工具。Stretch 需要兼顾有限臂行程、车体净空和工具选择，完成稳定交付。
H2C-B04-L3.description_en: The cart route and heavy crate are unchanged, but extra tool distractors appear. Stretch must account for arm stroke, cart clearance and tool suitability.

H2C-B04-T02.title_zh: Stretch 使用低位推杆运货
H2C-B04-T02.title_en: Stretch transports cargo using a low push bar
H2C-B04-T02.description_zh: 推车南侧安装了适合低位接触的推杆，货物仍需随车穿过错位通道。此项关注单臂身体与工具高度的适配，以及转向时重新接近的空间。
H2C-B04-T02.description_en: A low push bar is mounted on the cart’s south side. The loaded cart must still pass staggered openings, testing interface height and room to reposition during turns.

H2C-I02.title_zh: 载货车无法通行时退出
H2C-I02.title_en: Exit when the loaded cart cannot pass
H2C-I02.description_zh: 两道通道被收窄，固定路缘进一步压缩车板所在高度的净宽。交付规则仍要求货箱留在车上，G1 需要识别这组冲突并空手退出。
H2C-I02.description_en: Narrowed passages and fixed curbs leave insufficient cart clearance. Since delivery still requires the crate on its cart, G1 must recognize infeasibility and exit empty-handed.
H2C-I02.scope_zh: 目标是正确声明不可行并在退出区停稳。
H2C-I02.scope_en: The goal is a correct infeasibility declaration and a stable stop in the exit area.

H5S-01.title_zh: 借助杠杆搬运百公斤货箱
H5S-01.title_en: Move a 100 kg crate using lifting tools
H5S-01.description_zh: 百公斤货箱的一端已经由托架承住，另一端仍贴近地面。G1 要利用现场杠杆与支撑条件，使货物在运输中由工具承重，最终稳定交付。
H5S-01.description_en: One end of a 100 kg crate rests on a skate while the other remains near the floor. G1 must use available lifting tools for supported transport and stable delivery.

H5S-02.title_zh: 底脚摩擦增大后的重箱运输
H5S-02.title_en: Transport a crate with higher foot friction
H5S-02.description_zh: 货箱底脚与地面的摩擦增大，直接拖动需要更大力量。G1 仍要把百公斤货物送入目标区，运输过程不得让货箱在地面上拖行。
H5S-02.description_en: Higher friction at the crate’s feet increases the force needed for dragging. G1 must deliver the 100 kg load while keeping it tool-supported during transport.

H5S-03.title_zh: 单臂机器人操作锁止杠杆
H5S-03.title_en: A single-arm robot operates a locking lever
H5S-03.description_zh: 现场没有踏台杠杆，只有可锁止的手压杠杆与托架，货箱仍重达百公斤。Stretch 需要考虑单臂在施力、承托转换和运输之间的分工。
H5S-03.description_en: A locking hand lever and skates replace the foot-operated lever for a 100 kg crate. Stretch must manage force and support transitions with a single arm.

H5S-04.title_zh: 轮式双臂使用楔形托架
H5S-04.title_en: A wheeled dual-arm robot uses wedge skates
H5S-04.description_zh: 货箱远端已有普通托架，近端旁提供楔形鼻托架与固定路缘。R1 需要结合底盘推力和双臂接触，在稳定支撑条件下运走重箱。
H5S-04.description_en: One crate end rests on a skate; wedge-nose skates and a fixed curb are nearby. R1 must combine base force and arm contact for stable supported transport.

H5S-06.A.title_zh: 普通支点摩擦下的杠杆运输
H5S-06.A.title_en: Lever transport with ordinary support friction
H5S-06.A.description_zh: 杠杆旁同时有普通支点和槽形支点，外观不能直接揭示接触摩擦。G1 要结合实际可用支撑与力量条件，完成百公斤货箱的托架运输。
H5S-06.A.description_en: Ordinary and grooved fulcrums are both available, with contact friction not directly revealed. G1 must use feasible support and force conditions to transport the crate on skates.
H5S-06.A.scope_zh: 普通支点材料摩擦为隐藏配置 0.85。
H5S-06.A.scope_en: The ordinary fulcrum’s hidden material-friction setting is 0.85.

H5S-06.B.title_zh: 低摩擦支点下是否需要换工具
H5S-06.B.title_en: Assess tool choice with lower fulcrum friction
H5S-06.B.description_zh: 普通支点的材料摩擦降低，现场几何与另一配置保持一致。机器人需要依据接触效果判断原操作是否仍可用，而不能只看到参数变化就假定必须换工具。
H5S-06.B.description_en: The ordinary fulcrum’s material friction decreases while geometry stays fixed. The robot must assess whether the existing operation remains feasible instead of assuming a tool change is necessary.
H5S-06.B.scope_zh: 负对照：低材料摩擦没有排除原路线，不证明必须换支点。
H5S-06.B.scope_en: Negative control: reduced material friction does not rule out the original route or prove a fulcrum change necessary.

H5S-07.A.title_zh: 选择杠杆上的施力位置
H5S-07.A.title_en: Choose a force application point on a lever
H5S-07.A.description_zh: 同一锁止杠杆提供两个不同机械优势的按压点，货箱和托架布局不变。Stretch 需要把自身下压力与杠杆行程结合起来，安排承托和运输。
H5S-07.A.description_en: A locking lever offers two mechanical advantages with unchanged crate and skate geometry. Stretch must relate available downward force to lever travel for supported transport.
H5S-07.A.scope_zh: 本配置升降柱上下力限均为一百牛，能力参数隐藏。
H5S-07.A.scope_en: Hidden lift-column force limits are 100 N in both directions.

H5S-07.B.title_zh: 下压力受限时选择杠杆位置
H5S-07.B.title_en: Choose a lever point with limited downward force
H5S-07.B.description_zh: 杠杆仍有两个按压点，但 Stretch 的隐藏下压力明显减小。机器人需要判断施力位置是否能提供足够抬升空间，再完成托架承重的运输。
H5S-07.B.description_en: The lever still offers two contact points, but hidden downward force is reduced. Stretch must assess whether a contact point provides enough lifting clearance for supported transport.
H5S-07.B.scope_zh: 本配置升降柱向下力限为五牛、向上为一百牛。
H5S-07.B.scope_en: Lift-column limits are 5 N downward and 100 N upward.

H5S-08.A.title_zh: 推力充足时比较两类装载工具
H5S-08.A.title_en: Compare loading tools with higher drive torque
H5S-08.A.description_zh: 现场同时有楔形托架和手压杠杆，机器人要把重箱装到工具上再运输。R1 的隐藏轮子力矩较高，需要结合实际推力与工具接触选择可行操作。
H5S-08.A.description_en: Wedge skates and a hand lever offer loading options before transport. R1 has the higher hidden drive-torque setting and must assess available force and tool contact.
H5S-08.A.scope_zh: 轮子力矩上限为十五牛米；仅覆盖声明的配对配置。
H5S-08.A.scope_en: Wheel-torque limit is 15 Nm; coverage is limited to the declared paired configuration.

H5S-08.B.title_zh: 推力受限时重新评估装载工具
H5S-08.B.title_en: Reassess loading tools with limited drive torque
H5S-08.B.description_zh: 工具和货箱布局不变，但 R1 的隐藏轮子力矩降低。机器人需要重新评估推入工具所需的力，寻找仍能建立稳定承托的装载与运输方式。
H5S-08.B.description_en: Tool and crate geometry stay unchanged while R1’s hidden drive torque drops. It must reassess loading force and find a feasible way to establish support and transport the crate.
H5S-08.B.scope_zh: 轮子力矩上限为六牛米；不宣称所有楔入策略都不可行。
H5S-08.B.scope_en: Wheel-torque limit is 6 Nm; this does not rule out every possible wedge strategy.

H5S-09.title_zh: 工具不足以搬运重箱时退出
H5S-09.title_en: Exit when available tools cannot move the crate
H5S-09.description_zh: 百公斤货箱平放在地面，没有预垫托架，现场杠杆的机械优势也有限。Stretch 需要综合下压和推动能力判断可行性，保持空手进入退出区。
H5S-09.description_en: The 100 kg crate lies flat without a preplaced skate, and available leverage is limited. Stretch must assess pressing and pushing limits and exit empty-handed.
H5S-09.scope_zh: 目标为正确退出；不可行结论限于声明场景与路线类别。
H5S-09.scope_en: Correct exit is the goal; infeasibility is scoped to the declared scene and route classes.

H5S-05.G1.title_zh: G1 从多类工具中选择搬运方式
H5S-05.G1.description_zh: 同一个百公斤目标旁提供踏台杠杆、手压杠杆、楔形托架等候选。新增工具停放在远处，不能只依赖离货物最近的物件。
H5S-05.G1.description_en: Several tool types are available for the same 100 kg load, including foot and hand levers and wedge skates. Additional tools are parked away from the cargo, so proximity alone does not establish suitability.
H5S-05.G1.scope_zh: 各身体使用独立布置，不是完全相同世界的性能排名。
H5S-05.G1.scope_en: Each body uses a separate layout; this is not a ranking in an identical world.

H5S-05.R1.title_zh: R1 从多类工具中选择搬运方式
H5S-05.R1.description_zh: 同一个百公斤目标旁提供踏台杠杆、手压杠杆、楔形托架等候选。工具分散停放，选定之后还要实际取用并安排通行空间。
H5S-05.R1.description_en: Several tool types are available for the same 100 kg load, including foot and hand levers and wedge skates. Tools are parked away from the work area and must be fetched with enough room for transport.
H5S-05.R1.scope_zh: 各身体使用独立布置，不是完全相同世界的性能排名。
H5S-05.R1.scope_en: Each body uses a separate layout; this is not a ranking in an identical world.

H5S-05.S3.title_zh: Stretch 从多类工具中选择搬运方式
H5S-05.S3.description_zh: 同一个百公斤目标旁提供踏台杠杆、手压杠杆、楔形托架等候选。单伸缩臂需要在操作工具与承托转换之间安排可执行的动作。
H5S-05.S3.description_en: Several tool types are available for the same 100 kg load, including foot and hand levers and wedge skates. A single telescoping arm must support an executable sequence of tool handling and support transitions.
H5S-05.S3.scope_zh: 各身体使用独立布置，不是完全相同世界的性能排名。
H5S-05.S3.scope_en: Each body uses a separate layout; this is not a ranking in an identical world.

H6-ORIG.G.title_en: Carry a box upstairs and back down
H6-ORIG.G.description_zh: 两公斤提手箱需要经过楼梯到达高处平台，再沿另一段楼梯返回地面。G1 必须兼顾载荷、落脚和身体平衡，最终放下箱子并停稳。
H6-ORIG.G.description_en: A 2 kg handled box must travel up stairs to a platform and down the other flight. G1 must coordinate load, footholds and balance before stable release.

H6-L1.S.title_zh: 单臂机器人使用小升降梯运货
H6-L1.S.title_en: A single-arm robot carries cargo in a small lift
H6-L1.S.description_zh: 楼梯旁新增小轿厢升降梯，提手箱仍要到达高处平台再返回底部。Stretch 需要处理载箱进出轿厢与平台停留，最后完成地面交付。
H6-L1.S.description_en: A small lift is added beside the stairs for the handled box’s trip up and back. Stretch must manage loaded cabin entry, platform dwell and floor delivery.

H6-L1.W.title_en: A wheeled dual-arm robot transports cargo via a ramp
H6-L1.W.description_zh: 固定坡道提供了楼梯以外的高处通路，箱子质量保持两公斤。R1 要兼顾带载上下坡、转向与平台停留，再把货物送回地面交付区。
H6-L1.W.description_en: A fixed ramp adds an alternative to stairs for a 2 kg load. R1 must manage loaded slopes, turns and platform dwell before returning the cargo to the floor.

H6-L2.G.title_zh: 协调预装货物的上下楼运输
H6-L2.G.title_en: Coordinate vertical transport of preloaded cargo
H6-L2.G.description_zh: 箱子已放在送货井底站轿厢中，现场还有坡道和其他升降设施。G1 需要协调货物到达高处平台并返回底站，而不是从地面开始抱箱运输。
H6-L2.G.description_en: The box starts inside the goods elevator’s lower cabin, with other routes available. G1 must coordinate its trip to the upper platform and back to the lower station.
H6-L2.G.scope_zh: 预装的一点四公斤箱；允许底站轿厢内交付，不包含原地面取箱与卸箱目标。
H6-L2.G.scope_en: Preloaded 1.4 kg box; lower-cabin delivery is allowed, excluding the original floor pickup and unloading goals.

H6-L2.S.title_en: Use a tray for a handleless box
H6-L2.S.description_zh: 无把手箱与托盘、坡道和升降设备同时在场，单夹爪难以直接抓住平面箱体。Stretch 需要协调承托工具与竖向通路，最终让箱子回到地面。
H6-L2.S.description_en: A handleless box, tray, ramp and lifts are available. Stretch’s single gripper must coordinate a support tool with vertical transport and return the box to the floor.

H6-L2.W.title_zh: 带托盘通过适合底盘的通路
H6-L2.W.title_en: Carry a tray through a body-compatible route
H6-L2.W.description_zh: 无把手箱需要托盘承载，但现场的小升降梯容不下 R1。机器人要把载荷、底盘尺寸和坡道通行一起考虑，完成高处停留与返回交付。
H6-L2.W.description_en: The handleless box needs tray support, but the small lift cannot fit R1. Load, base size and ramp access must be considered for the trip up and back.
H6-L2.W.scope_zh: 本项允许载箱托盘整体落地交付；箱子不必卸离托盘。
H6-L2.W.scope_en: The loaded tray may be delivered as a unit; unloading the box from it is not required.

H6-P01.G.A.title_zh: 协调隐藏质量的预装轻箱
H6-P01.G.A.title_en: Coordinate a preloaded box with hidden mass
H6-P01.G.A.description_zh: 外观相同的箱子质量不公开，已经放在送货井底站内，现场仅有楼梯和货井。G1 要在搬举规则下安排高处停留与返回，避免仅凭外观判断载荷。
H6-P01.G.A.description_en: An identical-looking box has hidden mass and starts in the goods elevator. With only stairs and the elevator available, G1 must respect lifting rules on the trip up and back.
H6-P01.G.A.scope_zh: 预装两公斤箱，允许底站轿厢交付；不证明选择了最优路线。
H6-P01.G.A.scope_en: Preloaded 2 kg box with lower-cabin delivery allowed; optimal route selection is not established.

H6-P01.G.B.title_zh: 协调超过携带限额的预装箱
H6-P01.G.B.title_en: Coordinate preloaded cargo above the carrying limit
H6-P01.G.B.description_zh: 箱子外观与轻载配对相同，但隐藏质量超过公开携带限额。G1 需要让货物完成高处停留与返回，同时避免用身体抬起不允许携带的载荷。
H6-P01.G.B.description_en: The box looks like its paired light case but exceeds the carrying limit. G1 must complete the upper-platform trip and return without lifting the prohibited load.
H6-P01.G.B.scope_zh: 预装三公斤箱，允许底站轿厢交付，不包含地面取箱和卸箱。
H6-P01.G.B.scope_en: Preloaded 3 kg box; lower-cabin delivery is allowed and floor pickup and unloading are excluded.

H6-P02.W.A.title_zh: 轮子力矩较高时选择竖向路线
H6-P02.W.A.title_en: Select a vertical route with higher wheel torque
H6-P02.W.A.description_zh: 高处平台同时连接坡道与大轿厢升降梯，提手箱重两公斤。R1 的轮子能力参数隐藏，需要结合负载与通路条件安排往返运输。
H6-P02.W.A.description_en: A ramp and a large lift both reach the upper platform for a 2 kg load. R1’s drive capability is hidden, requiring attention to the loaded route.
H6-P02.W.A.scope_zh: 本配置轮子力矩上限为十五牛米。
H6-P02.W.A.scope_en: This configuration has a 15 Nm wheel-torque limit.

H6-P02.W.B.title_zh: 轮子力矩受限时选择竖向路线
H6-P02.W.B.title_en: Select a vertical route with limited wheel torque
H6-P02.W.B.description_zh: 坡道与大升降梯仍在原处，但 R1 的隐藏轮子力矩降低。机器人要重新评估带载爬坡与轿厢通行条件，让两公斤箱完成高处往返。
H6-P02.W.B.description_en: The ramp and large lift remain unchanged, but hidden drive torque is reduced. R1 must reassess loaded slope and cabin access for the 2 kg box’s round trip.
H6-P02.W.B.scope_zh: 本配置轮子力矩上限为四牛米。
H6-P02.W.B.scope_en: This configuration has a 4 Nm wheel-torque limit.

H6-P03.S.A.title_zh: 隐藏轻载下安排升降运输
H6-P03.S.A.title_en: Arrange vertical transport with a hidden light load
H6-P03.S.A.description_zh: 小升降梯与送货井同时可用，提手箱的质量不公开。Stretch 要判断自身携带规则与设备用途的关系，让箱子到达平台后再返回地面。
H6-P03.S.A.description_en: A small lift and a goods elevator are both available, while box mass is hidden. Stretch must relate its carrying rules to the equipment for a trip up and back.
H6-P03.S.A.scope_zh: 本配置箱子质量为一点八公斤。
H6-P03.S.A.scope_en: The box in this configuration weighs 1.8 kg.

H6-P03.S.B.title_zh: 超携带限额时安排机械运送
H6-P03.S.B.title_en: Arrange mechanical transport above the carrying limit
H6-P03.S.B.description_zh: 外观相同的提手箱变得更重，超过 Stretch 的公开携带上限。机器人需要考虑推动与机械运送的合法方式，完成平台停留和地面交付。
H6-P03.S.B.description_en: The same-looking box becomes heavier than Stretch’s carrying limit. It must consider permitted pushing and mechanical transport for platform dwell and floor delivery.
H6-P03.S.B.scope_zh: 本配置箱子质量为二点六公斤，不允许身体抱持运输。
H6-P03.S.B.scope_en: The 2.6 kg box may not be carried by the robot.

M2-1.title_zh: 双 G1 带长箱通过转角
M2-1.title_en: Two G1 robots carry a long crate around a corner
M2-1.description_zh: 长箱从地面开始，两台 G1 位于两端，沿途有 L 形转角。机器人需要协调起箱、朝向和释放，避免长物端部扫到通道边界。
M2-1.description_en: A long crate starts on the floor with a G1 at each end. The team must coordinate lifting, orientation and release through an L-shaped corridor.
M2-1.scope_zh: 声明的轻载实例，长箱质量为零点二五公斤。
M2-1.scope_en: Declared light-load instance with a 0.25 kg crate.

M2-2.title_zh: 不同身体把长箱交到接收架
M2-2.title_en: Different bodies deliver a long crate onto supports
M2-2.description_zh: G1 与 Stretch 从地面共同接近长箱，需要沿直通道送到两个固定接收支点。身体高度与工作空间不同，卸载后双方还必须完全脱离货物。
M2-2.description_en: G1 and Stretch move a floor-starting crate along a straight corridor to two fixed receiving supports. Different workspaces must align before both robots fully release it.
M2-2.scope_zh: 零点二五公斤长箱；本项使用直通道与接收架，不代表原 L 形路线。
M2-2.scope_en: 0.25 kg crate in a straight-corridor receiving-support scene, not the original L-shaped route.

M2-3.title_zh: 双 G1 搬运更重的长箱
M2-3.title_en: Two G1 robots carry a heavier long crate
M2-3.description_zh: 通道与双机起点保持不变，长箱质量比轻载配置增加。两台 G1 要在同一转角几何下重新协调承托与运动，完成地面交付和释放。
M2-3.description_en: The corridor and starts are unchanged while crate mass increases. Two G1 robots must coordinate support and motion through the same turn before floor delivery.
M2-3.scope_zh: 长箱质量为零点五公斤；不代表未知物性辨识能力。
M2-3.scope_en: The crate weighs 0.5 kg; this does not establish unknown-property identification.

M2-4.title_zh: 不同身体交付更重的长箱
M2-4.title_en: Different bodies deliver a heavier crate
M2-4.description_zh: 直通道、接收架与机器人组合不变，长箱质量增加到轻载配置的两倍。G1 和 Stretch 需要协调两端受力，让两个支点接管载荷后再撤离。
M2-4.description_en: The straight corridor, receiving supports and team remain fixed while crate mass doubles. G1 and Stretch must transfer the load to both supports before withdrawing.
M2-4.scope_zh: 零点五公斤长箱与接收架配置，不验证拖板机制选择。
M2-4.scope_en: 0.5 kg crate and receiving-support configuration; sled-mechanism selection is not evaluated.

M2-5.title_zh: 清出转角后协作搬运长箱
M2-5.title_en: Clear a corner for cooperative crate transport
M2-5.description_zh: 加重长箱的通路转角处多了一只可移动障碍，附近提供暂存区。双 G1 需要把清障与承托运输安排在同一任务中，并保留长箱转弯空间。
M2-5.description_en: A movable obstacle blocks the heavier crate’s turning area, with a storage zone nearby. Two G1 robots must coordinate clearing and transport while preserving turning clearance.

M2-6.title_zh: 三台 G1 分配清障与搬运工作
M2-6.title_en: Three G1 robots allocate clearing and carrying work
M2-6.description_zh: 障碍与长箱布局不变，场景增加第三台 G1。团队需要安排清障、货物承托与等待位置，完成转角运输后让所有机器人独立停稳。
M2-6.description_en: A third G1 joins the unchanged obstacle-and-crate layout. The team must allocate clearing, support and waiting positions, then finish with all robots independently stable.
M2-6.scope_zh: 不要求三台同时抬箱，也不由本片推断第三台的效率收益。
M2-6.scope_en: Three-way lifting is not required, and efficiency gains from the third robot are not established.

F5-01-L1.title_zh: 双单臂机器人搬面板过门
F5-01-L1.title_en: Two single-arm robots carry a panel through a doorway
F5-01-L1.description_zh: 两台 Stretch 共同承托半柔性面板，门道限制了面板与底盘的通过姿态。任务要求把面板送到指定位置并放稳，同时完成实际工具撤离。
F5-01-L1.description_en: Two Stretch robots support a semi-flexible panel through a doorway. Panel and base clearance must be coordinated before stable placement and physical tool withdrawal.

F5-01-L2.title_zh: 受限门道中的面板交付
F5-01-L2.title_en: Deliver a panel through a restricted doorway
F5-01-L2.description_zh: 门道宽度限制了两台轮式单臂机器人的相对位置，面板还需要保持可控形状。双方要协调通过狭窄区域，最终让面板独立承托并稳定停留。
F5-01-L2.description_en: A restricted doorway constrains the relative positions of two single-arm mobile robots. They must coordinate panel shape and passage before independently supported delivery.
F5-01-L2.scope_zh: 范围为面板交付；工具仍由手指持握在面板之外，不计独立落放或存放。
F5-01-L2.scope_en: Scope is panel delivery; tools remain finger-held away from the panel, without separate placement or storage credit.

F5-01-L3.title_zh: 双机带面板通过 L 形通道
F5-01-L3.title_en: Carry a panel around an L-shaped corridor
F5-01-L3.description_zh: 长面板需要经过两段相连的通道并完成转向，机器人不能只沿直线保持固定队形。两台 Stretch 要共同控制姿态与支撑，完成独立交付。
F5-01-L3.description_en: A long panel must turn between connected corridor segments. Two Stretch robots must adjust their relative motion and support rather than maintain a fixed straight-line formation.
F5-01-L3.scope_zh: 采用两米宽 L 形通道与转向区；交付后工具仍持握，独立存放不在范围内。
F5-01-L3.scope_en: Uses a 2 m L-shaped corridor and turning area; tools remain held after delivery, without separate storage.

F5-02-L1.title_zh: 按目标方向把面板放入框中
F5-02-L1.title_en: Place a panel into a frame at the target orientation
F5-02-L1.description_zh: 面板不仅要被运到安装位置，还必须与框体方向和支撑位置相符。双机需要协调两端姿态，放置后撤离工具，使面板保持稳定。
F5-02-L1.description_en: The panel must match the frame’s orientation and support geometry, not merely reach it. The team must coordinate both ends and withdraw tools after stable placement.

F5-02-L2.title_zh: 通过受限侧口安装面板
F5-02-L2.title_en: Install a panel through a restricted side opening
F5-02-L2.description_zh: 安装框的侧向开口受到限制，面板与工具不能同时任意穿入。两台 Stretch 需要安排姿态和承托转换，完成安装、卸载及工具存放。
F5-02-L2.description_en: A restricted side opening limits simultaneous access for the panel and tools. Two Stretch robots must coordinate pose and support transitions for installation, unloading and tool storage.
F5-02-L2.scope_zh: 覆盖侧向受限实例，不覆盖旧纵向尺寸不足的开口。
F5-02-L2.scope_en: Covers the laterally restricted instance, not the earlier opening with insufficient longitudinal clearance.

F5-02-L3.title_zh: 面板卡边后的安装恢复
F5-02-L3.title_en: Recover from a panel edge jam
F5-02-L3.description_zh: 面板在安装过程中出现真实卡边，继续用力可能使接触状态更差。机器人需要根据卡住的位置调整操作，重新建立可行接触并完成安装与工具存放。
F5-02-L3.description_en: A real edge jam interrupts installation, and continued force may worsen contact. The robots must respond to the jam, restore feasible contact and finish installation and tool storage.
F5-02-L3.scope_zh: 覆盖卡边恢复；不包含折叠、回弹故障或旧纵向窄框。
F5-02-L3.scope_en: Covers edge-jam recovery, excluding folding, rebound failures and the earlier longitudinally narrow frame.

H6-I01.S.title_zh: Stretch 面对只有楼梯的运输路线
H6-I01.S.title_en: Stretch faces a stairs-only transport route
H6-I01.S.description_zh: 场景只有楼梯和高处平台，没有坡道、升降设备或可改造通路的物体。Stretch 需要判断轮式底盘无法合法完成此任务，保持空手进入退出区。
H6-I01.S.description_en: Only stairs and an upper platform are available, with no ramp, lift or route-building objects. Stretch must recognize the wheeled base’s limitation and exit empty-handed.
H6-I01.S.scope_zh: 目标为正确退出，不计作楼层运输。
H6-I01.S.scope_en: Correct exit is the goal, not inter-level transport.

H6-I01.W.title_zh: R1 面对只有楼梯的运输路线
H6-I01.W.title_en: R1 faces a stairs-only transport route
H6-I01.W.description_zh: 场景只有楼梯和高处平台，没有坡道、升降设备或可改造通路的物体。R1 需要判断轮式底盘无法合法完成此任务，保持空手进入退出区。
H6-I01.W.description_en: Only stairs and an upper platform are available, with no ramp, lift or route-building objects. R1 must recognize the wheeled base’s limitation and exit empty-handed.
H6-I01.W.scope_zh: 目标为正确退出，不计作楼层运输。
H6-I01.W.scope_en: Correct exit is the goal, not inter-level transport.

M4-01.title_zh: 双 Go2 牵引货物通过转角
M4-01.title_en: Two Go2 robots tow cargo around a corner
M4-01.description_zh: 十五公斤货物由地面或平台承重，需要通过 L 形通道送入目标区。两台四足机器人从不同牵引位置共同引导货物，转角处还要留出货物净空。
M4-01.description_en: Floor- or platform-supported 15 kg cargo must reach the target through an L-shaped corridor. Two quadrupeds guide the cargo from separate towing positions while preserving cargo clearance at the turn.
M4-01.scope_zh: 绳索预先连接牵引接口，不含自主连接或手部抓绳。靠近镜头的墙面采用剖视显示；原始执行保留墙体碰撞。
M4-01.scope_en: Ropes are preconnected to towing interfaces; autonomous attachment and hand-held ropes are excluded. Camera-side walls are shown as a cutaway; the original execution retains wall collisions.

M4-02.title_zh: 单 G1 牵引货物通过转角
M4-02.title_en: One G1 robot tow cargo around a corner
M4-02.description_zh: 十五公斤货物由地面或平台承重，需要通过 L 形通道送入目标区。单台人形机器人独自承担方向与牵引节奏的控制，转角处还要留出货物净空。
M4-02.description_en: Floor- or platform-supported 15 kg cargo must reach the target through an L-shaped corridor. One humanoid controls the direction and towing pace on its own while preserving cargo clearance at the turn.
M4-02.scope_zh: 绳索预先连接牵引接口，不含自主连接或手部抓绳。靠近镜头的墙面采用剖视显示；原始执行保留墙体碰撞。
M4-02.scope_en: Ropes are preconnected to towing interfaces; autonomous attachment and hand-held ropes are excluded. Camera-side walls are shown as a cutaway; the original execution retains wall collisions.

M4-03.title_zh: 三台 Go2 牵引货物通过转角
M4-03.title_en: Three Go2 robots tow cargo around a corner
M4-03.description_zh: 十五公斤货物由地面或平台承重，需要通过 L 形通道送入目标区。三台四足机器人的相对位置会共同影响绳索方向，转角处还要留出货物净空。
M4-03.description_en: Floor- or platform-supported 15 kg cargo must reach the target through an L-shaped corridor. The relative positions of three quadrupeds shape the towing directions while preserving cargo clearance at the turn.
M4-03.scope_zh: 绳索预先连接牵引接口，不含自主连接或手部抓绳。靠近镜头的墙面采用剖视显示；原始执行保留墙体碰撞。
M4-03.scope_en: Ropes are preconnected to towing interfaces; autonomous attachment and hand-held ropes are excluded. Camera-side walls are shown as a cutaway; the original execution retains wall collisions.

M4-04.title_zh: 双 G1 牵引货物通过转角
M4-04.title_en: Two G1 robots tow cargo around a corner
M4-04.description_zh: 十五公斤货物由地面或平台承重，需要通过 L 形通道送入目标区。两台人形机器人需要协调步行方向与相互间距，转角处还要留出货物净空。
M4-04.description_en: Floor- or platform-supported 15 kg cargo must reach the target through an L-shaped corridor. Two humanoids coordinate walking directions and their spacing while preserving cargo clearance at the turn.
M4-04.scope_zh: 绳索预先连接牵引接口，不含自主连接或手部抓绳。靠近镜头的墙面采用剖视显示；原始执行保留墙体碰撞。
M4-04.scope_en: Ropes are preconnected to towing interfaces; autonomous attachment and hand-held ropes are excluded. Camera-side walls are shown as a cutaway; the original execution retains wall collisions.

M4-05.title_zh: G1 与双 Go2 牵引货物通过转角
M4-05.title_en: G1 with two Go2 robots tow cargo around a corner
M4-05.description_zh: 十五公斤货物由地面或平台承重，需要通过 L 形通道送入目标区。人形与四足机器人组成混合团队，需要协调不同的步行身体，转角处还要留出货物净空。
M4-05.description_en: Floor- or platform-supported 15 kg cargo must reach the target through an L-shaped corridor. A mixed humanoid and quadruped team must coordinate different locomotion bodies while preserving cargo clearance at the turn.
M4-05.scope_zh: 绳索预先连接牵引接口，不含自主连接或手部抓绳。靠近镜头的墙面采用剖视显示；原始执行保留墙体碰撞。
M4-05.scope_en: Ropes are preconnected to towing interfaces; autonomous attachment and hand-held ropes are excluded. Camera-side walls are shown as a cutaway; the original execution retains wall collisions.

M4-06.title_zh: 四台 Go2 牵引货物通过转角
M4-06.title_en: Four Go2 robots tow cargo around a corner
M4-06.description_zh: 十五公斤货物由地面或平台承重，需要通过 L 形通道送入目标区。四台四足机器人共享有限通道，需要兼顾多条绳索与团队站位，转角处还要留出货物净空。
M4-06.description_en: Floor- or platform-supported 15 kg cargo must reach the target through an L-shaped corridor. Four quadrupeds share limited corridor space while coordinating multiple ropes and team positions while preserving cargo clearance at the turn.
M4-06.scope_zh: 绳索预先连接牵引接口，不含自主连接或手部抓绳。靠近镜头的墙面采用剖视显示；原始执行保留墙体碰撞。
M4-06.scope_en: Ropes are preconnected to towing interfaces; autonomous attachment and hand-held ropes are excluded. Camera-side walls are shown as a cutaway; the original execution retains wall collisions.

ASM-01.G.title_zh: 支撑倾斜夹具后完成装配
ASM-01.G.title_en: Support an inclined fixture for assembly
ASM-01.G.description_zh: 倾斜夹具需要独立支撑才能保持工作姿态，套筒与顶盖还需按装配关系落位。G1 要控制接触与承载转换，使整套结构在撤手后仍然稳定。
ASM-01.G.description_en: An inclined fixture needs independent support while the sleeve and cap are assembled. G1 must manage contact and load transfer so the structure remains stable after release.
ASM-01.G.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1 Dex3，在桌面完成操作。
ASM-01.G.scope_en: Tabletop manipulation by fixed-pelvis G1 with Dex3 hands.

ASM-02.G.title_zh: 从候选件中选择装配支撑
ASM-02.G.description_zh: 现场候选支撑的高度、可达性和承载效果不同，不能只看外形相似。G1 需要为倾斜夹具建立可用支撑，再把套筒与顶盖装好并撤手。
ASM-02.G.description_en: Support candidates differ in height, reachability and load-bearing behavior. G1 must establish usable fixture support before completing sleeve and cap assembly and releasing it.

ASM-03.G.title_zh: 组合短支架与垫片形成支撑
ASM-03.G.title_en: Combine a short stand and shim into a support
ASM-03.G.description_zh: 单个支撑件不足以直接满足夹具的承托条件，现场提供短支架与垫片。机器人需要让组合件通过真实接触传递载荷，再完成套筒和顶盖装配。
ASM-03.G.description_en: A single support does not meet the fixture’s needs. G1 must combine a short stand and shim into a real load-bearing contact chain for sleeve and cap assembly.
ASM-03.G.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1 Dex3；仅满足高度之和不算形成支撑。
ASM-03.G.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1 Dex3; matching total height alone does not establish support.

ASM-04.G.title_zh: 选择身体能执行的支撑方法
ASM-04.G.title_en: Choose a support method the body can execute
ASM-04.G.description_zh: 推入式楔块、抓放式支架和垫片同时在场，各自需要不同接触动作。G1 要结合三指手的操作能力选择方法，使夹具独立承托并完成装配。
ASM-04.G.description_en: A push-in wedge, graspable stand and shim require different contact actions. G1’s three-finger hands must execute a usable support method before completing assembly.
ASM-04.G.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1 Dex3；本片不代表未完成的 Stretch 对照。
ASM-04.G.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1 Dex3; this record does not represent the incomplete Stretch comparison.

JNG-01.title_zh: 连续三轮抽取并重搭木塔
JNG-01.title_en: Extract and restack blocks for three rounds
JNG-01.description_zh: 机器人要从非顶层抽出三根不同木条，再把它们放到塔顶指定槽位。每次抽取都会改变剩余结构，需要兼顾合法顺序、接触控制和最终稳定。
JNG-01.description_en: Three distinct non-top blocks must be extracted and placed in top slots. Each removal changes the structure, requiring legal ordering, controlled contact and final stability.
JNG-01.scope_zh: 固定骨盆三指参考模型。

JNG-02.title_zh: 判断木条是否可以安全移除
JNG-02.title_en: Judge whether a block can be removed
JNG-02.description_zh: 候选木条中混有承担结构载荷的部件，不能随意挑选看似容易抓到的一根。机器人需要判断可移除性，完成一次抽取、塔顶放置和稳定释放。
JNG-02.description_en: Some candidate blocks carry structural load, so easy access alone is insufficient. The robot must choose a removable block and complete one extraction and stable top placement.
JNG-02.scope_zh: 固定骨盆三指参考模型。

JNG-03.title_zh: 避免后续死局的抽取顺序
JNG-03.title_en: Choose an extraction order that avoids a dead end
JNG-03.description_zh: 眼前容易抽出的木条可能让后续两轮无路可走，塔体会随操作持续变化。机器人需要把三轮抽取与塔顶槽位一起考虑，保持结构可继续操作。
JNG-03.description_en: An easy first block can leave later rounds impossible. The robot must consider all three removals and top-slot placements while keeping the changing tower workable.
JNG-03.scope_zh: 固定骨盆三指参考模型。

JNG-07.title_zh: 探测木条松紧后调整选择
JNG-07.title_en: Probe block tightness and adjust the choice
JNG-07.description_zh: 外观相同的木条具有不同摩擦，单看位置不能判断抽取阻力。机器人需要依据实际接触与位移调整选择，必要时回退，完成一次抽取与重搭。
JNG-07.description_en: Identical-looking blocks have different friction. The robot must use measured contact and motion to adjust its choice, retreat when needed, and complete one extraction and restacking.
JNG-07.scope_zh: 固定骨盆三指参考模型；本项含受限探测与恢复过程。
JNG-07.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis three-finger reference model with scoped probing and recovery.

DF-01-G.title_zh: 在接触力限制下翻转圆盘
DF-01-G.title_en: Flip a disk under contact-force limits
DF-01-G.description_zh: 圆盘需要翻面后回到同一桌面目标位置，不能依靠快速甩动完成。G1 要在速度与接触力限制下协调双手和桌面支撑，最终撤手保持稳定。
DF-01-G.description_en: The disk must be flipped back onto the same tabletop target without fast throwing motions. G1 must coordinate hands and table support under speed and force limits.
DF-01-G.scope_zh: 固定骨盆、标称初态的特权状态参考。
DF-01-G.scope_en: Privileged-state reference with fixed pelvis and a nominal initial state.

DF-01-G-offset.title_zh: 横向偏移起点下翻转圆盘
DF-01-G-offset.title_en: Flip a disk from a laterally shifted start
DF-01-G-offset.description_zh: 圆盘起点与目标一起横向移动了三毫米，原有速度和接触力约束保持不变。机器人需要在这一独立位置配置中完成翻面、稳定落桌和撤手。
DF-01-G-offset.description_en: Both disk start and target shift laterally by 3 mm while force and speed rules stay fixed. The robot must flip, settle and release the disk in this separate configuration.
DF-01-G-offset.scope_zh: 固定骨盆的独立偏移配置，不代表随机位置覆盖。
DF-01-G-offset.scope_en: Separate fixed-pelvis offset configuration, not randomized position coverage.

DF-02-F.title_en: Flip a rimmed dish with five-finger hands
DF-02-F.description_zh: 带沿浅盘起初部分悬出桌边，盘沿改变了手指接触与支撑条件。G1 五指手需要在受力和失支撑时长限制下完成翻面，放稳后完全撤手。
DF-02-F.description_en: A rimmed dish starts partly over the table edge, changing finger contact and support. G1’s five-finger hands must flip and release it within force and support-loss limits.
DF-02-F.scope_zh: 固定基座的 Inspire 手配置；与三指手配对场景单列。
DF-02-F.scope_en: Fixed-base Inspire-hand configuration, listed separately from its paired three-finger case.

DF-02-G.title_en: Flip a rimmed dish with three-finger hands
DF-02-G.description_zh: 浅盘的边沿和桌边悬伸限制了三指手的可用接触位置。G1 要在速度与接触力约束下保持连续支撑，将浅盘翻面并稳定放入目标位置。
DF-02-G.description_en: The dish rim and table-edge overhang constrain three-finger contact. G1 must maintain support under speed and force limits, flip the dish and settle it at the target.
DF-02-G.scope_zh: 固定基座的 Dex3 手配置，覆盖声明的标称初态。
DF-02-G.scope_en: Fixed-base Dex3 configuration covering the declared nominal initial state.

DF-03-G.title_zh: 局部受力敏感的浅盘翻面
DF-03-G.title_en: Flip a dish with sensitive local-load limits
DF-03-G.description_zh: 浅盘对局部接触载荷更敏感，不能只控制双手合力而忽略单点受力。机器人需要兼顾支撑转换和轻柔操作，把浅盘翻面后放稳并撤手。
DF-03-G.description_en: The dish has stricter local contact-load limits, so total hand force alone is insufficient. The robot must manage gentle support transitions through flipping and stable release.
DF-03-G.scope_zh: 固定基座；四牛局部载荷上限是刚体损伤代理，不是可变形破损模型。
DF-03-G.scope_en: Fixed base; the 4 N local-load limit is a rigid-body damage proxy, not deformable breakage.

DF-04-G.title_zh: 双臂自行安排圆盘翻面
DF-04-G.title_en: Choose a disk-flipping sequence with two arms
DF-04-G.description_zh: 圆盘初始部分悬伸在桌边，任务不指定原先的动作顺序。G1 需要利用双臂与桌面可形成的支撑，在公开受力限制下完成翻面和稳定放置。
DF-04-G.description_en: The disk starts partly over the table edge without a prescribed action order. G1 can coordinate two arms and table support to flip and settle it under force limits.
DF-04-G.scope_zh: 执行期间基座固定；仅覆盖声明初态，不代表随机泛化。
DF-04-G.scope_en: The base stays fixed during execution; coverage is limited to the declared initial state.

DF-04-S.title_zh: 单臂自行安排圆盘翻面
DF-04-S.title_en: Choose a disk-flipping sequence with one arm
DF-04-S.description_zh: 圆盘与目标位置保持不变，但身体换成只有一条伸缩臂的 Stretch。机器人需要重新考虑抓持和桌面支撑的配合，在相同公开约束下翻面并撤手。
DF-04-S.description_en: The disk and target are unchanged, but Stretch has one telescoping arm. It must coordinate grasping with table support to flip and release under the same declared constraints.
DF-04-S.scope_zh: 执行期间底座固定；不把两种身体的见证解释为性能排名。
DF-04-S.scope_en: The base stays fixed during execution; paired witnesses do not establish a body-performance ranking.

DR-nominal_ccw.title_zh: 双臂把圆盘逆时针转三十度
DR-nominal_ccw.title_en: Rotate the disk thirty degrees counter-clockwise
DR-nominal_ccw.description_zh: 两台固定机械臂用末端推垫接触桌面圆盘，目标是改变朝向而尽量不移动圆心。机器人要协调双侧接触，使圆盘逆时针转到指定角度并停稳。
DR-nominal_ccw.description_en: Two fixed arms contact a tabletop disk with end pads. They must coordinate contacts for a 30-degree counter-clockwise turn while keeping the center in place.
DR-nominal_ccw.scope_zh: 固定基座双 Panda；不以该录像证明换接触点或双臂的必要性。
DR-nominal_ccw.scope_en: Two fixed-base Panda arms; this record does not prove that contact switching or both arms are necessary.

DR-wrap_cw.title_zh: 跨角度边界顺时针转动圆盘
DR-wrap_cw.title_en: Rotate clockwise across the angular wrap boundary
DR-wrap_cw.description_zh: 圆盘初始与目标朝向分处角度表示边界两侧，数值差不等于实际短转角。双臂需要选对旋转方向，同时控制圆心偏移并在目标朝向停稳。
DR-wrap_cw.description_en: Initial and target orientations straddle the angular wrap boundary, so their raw difference is misleading. The arms must choose the clockwise short turn and control center drift.
DR-wrap_cw.scope_zh: 固定基座双 Panda；目标由负一百七十度到正一百六十度。
DR-wrap_cw.scope_en: Two fixed-base Panda arms; target changes from −170° to +160°.

GEAR-01.G.title_zh: 按图装配并检验齿轮传动 · G1 三指手
GEAR-01.G.title_en: Assemble and test gear transmission · G1 three-finger hands
GEAR-01.G.description_zh: 齿轮与顶盖需要按装配关系落位，装好后还要用实体工具检查传动。正式 Dex3 三指手需要适配零件和工具的接触位置，最后归还工具并释放结构。
GEAR-01.G.description_en: Gears and a cover must be assembled and transmission tested with a physical tool. The Dex3 hands must fit contacts on parts and tools, followed by tool return and final release.
GEAR-01.G.scope_zh: 固定骨盆，桌面高零点七四米。
GEAR-01.G.scope_en: Fixed pelvis at a 0.74 m table.

GEAR-02.G.title_zh: 诊断并修复部分装好的齿轮组 · G1 三指手
GEAR-02.G.title_en: Diagnose and repair a partly assembled gear set · G1 three-finger hands
GEAR-02.G.description_zh: 齿轮组已部分装好却无法正常传动，需要定位装配问题并返工。正式 Dex3 三指手需要适配零件和工具的接触位置，修复后仍要完成实际验转和最终释放。
GEAR-02.G.description_en: A partly assembled gear set cannot transmit correctly and needs diagnosis and rework. The Dex3 hands must fit contacts on parts and tools before functional testing and final release.
GEAR-02.G.scope_zh: 固定骨盆，桌面高零点七四米。故障初态为中间齿轮倒置；保留零点三秒失支撑宽限。
GEAR-02.G.scope_en: Fixed pelvis at a 0.74 m table. The middle gear starts inverted; a 0.3 s loss-of-support grace period is retained.

GEAR-03.G.title_zh: 在多种拨转工具中完成装配验转 · G1 三指手
GEAR-03.G.title_en: Assemble and test with several turning tools · G1 three-finger hands
GEAR-03.G.description_zh: 现场有原拨转工具、细杆与宽杆，它们对手部抓持提出不同要求。正式 Dex3 三指手需要适配零件和工具的接触位置，完成齿轮装配与真实传动检查。
GEAR-03.G.description_en: The original turning tool and thin and wide rods require different grasps. The Dex3 hands must fit contacts on parts and tools to complete assembly and test physical transmission.
GEAR-03.G.scope_zh: 固定骨盆，桌面高零点七四米。
GEAR-03.G.scope_en: Fixed pelvis at a 0.74 m table.

GEAR-01.reference.title_zh: 按图装配并检验齿轮传动 · 三指参考身体
GEAR-01.reference.title_en: Assemble and test gear transmission · Three-finger reference body
GEAR-01.reference.description_zh: 齿轮与顶盖需要按装配关系落位，装好后还要用实体工具检查传动。三指参考身体在固定工作位完成各个接触阶段，最后归还工具并释放结构。
GEAR-01.reference.description_en: Gears and a cover must be assembled and transmission tested with a physical tool. The three-finger reference body works through the contact stages from a fixed position, followed by tool return and final release.
GEAR-01.reference.scope_zh: 固定骨盆，桌面高零点七四米。采用历史三指参考模型，与正式身体记录分列。
GEAR-01.reference.scope_en: Fixed pelvis at a 0.74 m table. Historical three-finger reference model, separate from official-body records.

GEAR-02.reference.title_zh: 诊断并修复部分装好的齿轮组 · 三指参考身体
GEAR-02.reference.title_en: Diagnose and repair a partly assembled gear set · Three-finger reference body
GEAR-02.reference.description_zh: 齿轮组已部分装好却无法正常传动，需要定位装配问题并返工。三指参考身体在固定工作位完成各个接触阶段，修复后仍要完成实际验转和最终释放。
GEAR-02.reference.description_en: A partly assembled gear set cannot transmit correctly and needs diagnosis and rework. The three-finger reference body works through the contact stages from a fixed position before functional testing and final release.
GEAR-02.reference.scope_zh: 固定骨盆，桌面高零点七四米。采用历史三指参考模型，与正式身体记录分列。故障初态为中间齿轮倒置；保留零点三秒失支撑宽限。
GEAR-02.reference.scope_en: Fixed pelvis at a 0.74 m table. Historical three-finger reference model, separate from official-body records. The middle gear starts inverted; a 0.3 s loss-of-support grace period is retained.

GEAR-03.reference.title_zh: 在多种拨转工具中完成装配验转 · 三指参考身体
GEAR-03.reference.title_en: Assemble and test with several turning tools · Three-finger reference body
GEAR-03.reference.description_zh: 现场有原拨转工具、细杆与宽杆，它们对手部抓持提出不同要求。三指参考身体在固定工作位完成各个接触阶段，完成齿轮装配与真实传动检查。
GEAR-03.reference.description_en: The original turning tool and thin and wide rods require different grasps. The three-finger reference body works through the contact stages from a fixed position to complete assembly and test physical transmission.

GEAR-03.F.title_zh: 在多种拨转工具中完成装配验转 · G1 五指手
GEAR-03.F.title_en: Assemble and test with several turning tools · G1 five-finger hands
GEAR-03.F.description_zh: 现场有原拨转工具、细杆与宽杆，它们对手部抓持提出不同要求。Inspire 五指手需要适配工具握持和拨转接触，完成齿轮装配与真实传动检查。
GEAR-03.F.description_en: The original turning tool and thin and wide rods require different grasps. The Inspire hands must adapt their grip and turning contact to complete assembly and test physical transmission.
GEAR-03.F.scope_zh: 固定骨盆，桌面高零点七四米。
GEAR-03.F.scope_en: Fixed pelvis at a 0.74 m table.

JNG-04.A.title_zh: 在受限空间抽取木条 · G1 三指手
JNG-04.A.title_en: Extract a block through constrained access · G1 with three-finger hands
JNG-04.A.description_zh: 木条周围的间隙限制了可用抓持与接近方向，三指手的几何也会影响操作。G1 三指手 需要选择身体能执行的接触方式，完成一次抽取和塔顶重放。
JNG-04.A.description_en: Clearance around a block constrains grasp and approach directions. G1 with three-finger hands must choose contacts its body can execute for one extraction and top placement.
JNG-04.A.scope_zh: 固定骨盆，使用单独声明的条件化几何，不代表四身体完全同世界比较。目标高五十一毫米，顶部间隙四毫米。
JNG-04.A.scope_en: Fixed pelvis with separately declared conditioned geometry; not an identical-world comparison across four bodies. The target is 51 mm high with 4 mm top clearance.

JNG-04.D.description_en: Clearance around a block constrains grasp and approach directions. Stretch must choose contacts its body can execute for one extraction and top placement.

JNG-05.A.title_zh: 把木条放入塔顶中间槽 · G1 三指手
JNG-05.A.title_en: Place a block into the middle top slot · G1 with three-finger hands
JNG-05.A.description_zh: 塔顶两侧槽位已经被占用，目标木条只能放入中间的有限空间。G1 三指手 要协调三指手的接近姿态与释放间隙，让木条获得真实支撑并保持稳定。
JNG-05.A.description_en: Both outer top slots are occupied, leaving a constrained middle slot. G1 with three-finger hands must coordinate approach and release clearance so the block gains stable physical support.
JNG-05.A.scope_zh: 固定骨盆，使用单独声明的条件化几何，不代表四身体完全同世界比较。中槽开口七十二毫米，顶部间隙八毫米。
JNG-05.A.scope_en: Fixed pelvis with separately declared conditioned geometry; not an identical-world comparison across four bodies. The middle opening is 72 mm wide with 8 mm top clearance.

JNG-06.A.title_zh: 同时规划木条顺序与接近方向 · G1 三指手
JNG-06.A.title_en: Plan block order together with access direction · G1 with three-finger hands
JNG-06.A.description_zh: 三轮操作同时受到可移除性、塔顶槽位和身体可接近侧的限制。G1 三指手 需要随着塔体变化安排三指手的接触与转向，避免后续动作失去空间。

JNG-06.A.scope_zh: 固定骨盆，使用单独声明的条件化几何，不代表四身体完全同世界比较。本项使用单独修整的底条。
